summary:

- Raid Cost & Raw Sulfur Calculator with multi-target breakdown
- Base Upkeep & Decay Protection Matrix with exact block-tier math
- Weapon TTK & Ballistics Comparison Matrix against all armor sets
- Scrap & Tech Tree Path Planner with Monument Loot Matrix
- Electrical & Industrial Automation Wire Guide
- Industrial Rust oxide aesthetic integration with custom theme tokens and seamless navbar/library navigation
